Advance Petrochemicals Ltd carries severe fundamental risks that are masked by a superficial headline earnings multiple [E1]. The company's true operational health is reflected in an exceptionally weak Return on Assets of 0.06% which falls drastically short of the sector benchmark of 3.94% [E8]. Compounded profit growth paints a picture of long-term structural decline, contracting by 8% over 10 years, accelerating downward by 36% over 5 years, and plunging by 68% over 3 years [E18, E19, E20]. This multi-year deterioration stands in stark contrast to the sector median profit growth of 34.9%, leaving the company far behind its industry peers [E68]. Furthermore, the data provider key-ratios flag an alarming P/E of 496.36x against a sector benchmark of 21.85x and a P/B of 3.71x against a sector benchmark of 1.79x [E6, E7]. Shareholders receive zero compensation for these risks, as evidenced by a dividend yield of 0.00% [E4].
